İşte kütüphane, ve şurada resim odası.
Bu spor salonudur. Şu müzik odasıdır.
Zara: İyi günler! Okula hoş geldiniz!
Ziyaretçi diyor: Ne güzel bir okul!

questions.q: Who comes to the school today?
What does the visitor say first?
What does the visitor say at the end?

int.title: Rules on the Sports Field
int.subtitle: Read carefully and answer the questions!
sentences: Leo and Deniz are on the sports field.
Mr. Cole: Here are the rules for the field.
You must wear the sports shoes.
You must listen to the teacher.
You mustn't push pupils.
You mustn't drop litter on the field.
Leo and Deniz play football together.
Mr Cole: Good job, boys!
Leo and Deniz: We follow the rules!
translations: Leo ve Deniz birlikte futbol oynuyor.

questions.q: What mustn't you do to your friends?
What mustn't you drop on the field?
What do Leo and Deniz play?

int.title: A Day in the Library
int.subtitle: Read carefully and answer the questions!
sentences: Ada and Zara are in the library.
Ms. Shaw is the librarian.
There are many books on the shelves.
Ada: Where are the story books?
Ms. Shaw: They are on this shelf.
Zara: Where are the picture books?
Ms. Shaw: They are on that shelf.
Ada and Zara read two new books.
Ms. Shaw: Be quiet, please. This is the library.
The girls read quietly. What a nice day!
translations: Ada ve Zara iki yeni kitap okuyor.
Ms. Shaw diyor: Lütfen sessiz olun. Burası kütüphane.
Kızlar sessizce okuyor. Ne güzel bir gün!

questions.q: What does Ms. Shaw ask the girls to do?
questions.qTr: Ms. Shaw kızlardan ne yapmalarını ister?

int.title: The Children's Day Show
int.subtitle: Read carefully and answer the questions!
sentences: What month is it? It is April.
The 23rd of April is Children's Day in Türkiye.
There is a big show at school.
Maya and Kerem are ready for the show.
There are many flags in the sports hall.
That is the stage. It is red and white.
Children from many countries are here, too.
Maya: Happy Children's Day!
Ms. Hart: This is a special day for all children.
Everyone is happy at the show.
translations: Maya diyor: Çocuk Bayramı kutlu olsun!
Ms. Hart diyor: Bu tüm çocuklar için özel bir gün.

inf.title: A Surprise at School
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: It is a cold morning in February.
Maya is at school early.
There is something in the corridor.
There is a big box at the library.
Maya: What is that, Mr. Cole?
Mr. Cole: It is a secret. Ask Ms. Hart!
Maya must find Ms. Hart.
She is at the office.
Ms. Hart is quiet. She is happy!
Leo is in the corridor. The box is there, too.
Leo: Is that a surprise?
Ms. Hart: Wait and see!
Everyone is happy — the box is full of new books for the library!
translations: Mr. Cole: O bir sır. Ms. Hart'a sor!
Ms. Hart diyor: Bekle ve gör!
Herkes mutlu — kutu kütüphane için yeni kitaplarla dolu!

questions.q: What month is it in the story?
Where does Maya find the box?
questions.hint: Find the word box in the text.

questions.q: Why does Maya run to the office?
questions.hint: Read what Mr. Cole says to Maya.

questions.q: Why does Ms. Hart say nothing?
questions.qTr: Ms. Hart neden hiçbir şey söylemez?
questions.correct: Because the box is a surprise.
questions.hint: Think about what Leo asks Ms. Hart.

questions.q: How does everyone feel at the end?

inf.title: When Is the Party?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the answer!
sentences: Maya is very happy today.
Leo: When is your birthday, Maya?
Maya: It is in May!
Leo: What month is it?
Ms Hart: It is July.
Leo: May is not July!
Leo: Is the birthday party in the summer holiday?
Maya: Yes!
Ms. Hart: Have a good weekend, everyone!
Maya: Thank you! See you later!
At home, there are balloons in the room.
There are gifts and candles on the table.
Maya is very happy. The birthday party is in the summer holiday!
translations: Leo: Doğum günün ne zaman, Maya?
Leo: Doğum günü partisi yaz tatilinde mi?
Ms. Hart diyor: Herkese iyi hafta sonları!
Maya çok mutlu. Doğum günü partisi yaz tatilinde!

questions.hint: Find Maya's answer about her birthday.

questions.q: What month is it now in the story?
questions.hint: Find what Ms. Hart says about the month.

questions.q: Why is Maya's birthday party in the summer holiday?
questions.qTr: Maya'nın doğum günü partisi neden yaz tatilinde?
questions.correct: Because her birthday is in May and it is now July.
wrong: Because she wants a big party.
questions.hint: Think about when Maya's birthday is and what month it is now.

questions.q: What does Maya do at home?
questions.correct: She decorates her room with balloons.
questions.hint: Find Maya at home in the text.

inf.title: The Wet Floor
inf.subtitle: Read and think! Find the answer between the lines.
sentences: It is a rainy morning.
The floor in the corridor is wet.
There is a yellow sign from Mr. Cole.
The sign: You mustn't run here!
Leo is in a hurry. He is ready to run.
The wet floor is there. The sign is there, too.
Leo is slow and careful.
Mr. Cole: Good boy, Leo!
Leo is careful. The floor is wet and not safe!
translations: Mr. Cole'dan sarı bir işaret var.
Islak zemin oradadır. İşaret de oradadır.
Leo dikkatlidir. Zemin ıslak ve güvenli değil!

questions.q: What does the yellow sign mean?
questions.hint: Think about the sign and the wet floor.
Think about why running is dangerous.

questions.q: What kind of boy is Leo?
Why is a wet floor dangerous?
questions.correct: It is not safe to run
questions.hint: Think about why Mr. Cole puts a sign.

inf.title: Who Helps Here?
inf.subtitle: Read and think! Find the answer between the lines.
sentences: Ada is not happy. The book is old and broken.
The old book is not good for class.
Ms. Hart: Go and ask the right person.
Ada is in a quiet room with many shelves.
There are hundreds of books here.
A kind woman is at the desk.
Ms. Shaw: Here is a new book for you.
Ada: Thank you!
Who is the kind woman? She is the librarian!
translations: Ada mutlu değil. Kitap eski ve bozuk.
Eski kitap ders için iyi değil.
Ms. Hart: Git ve doğru kişiye sor.
Ada birçok rafı olan sessiz bir odadadır.
Ms. Shaw: İşte sana yeni bir kitap.

questions.correct: Her book is old and broken

questions.q: Which room does Ada go to?
questions.hint: Think about a quiet room with many shelves and books.
Think about who works with books.

questions.q: How do we know she is the librarian?
questions.correct: She is in the room with books
questions.hint: Think about the room and the books.

questions.q: How does Ada feel at the end?

inf.title: Warm Days Are Coming
inf.subtitle: Read and think! Find the answer between the lines.
sentences: The weather is warm.
The school garden is full of flowers.
Maya: The summer holiday is in June!
Ms. Hart: Yes! It is one month.
It is not June.
Deniz: What month is it?
Ms. Hart: Look at the flowers and think!
Maya: It is May!
In June, it is summer. The holiday is here!
translations: Ms. Hart: Evet! Bir ay var.
Ms. Hart diyor: Çiçeklere bak ve düşün!

questions.hint: It is one month before June. Think!

questions.q: How do we know summer is near?
questions.correct: It is warm and full of flowers
questions.hint: Think about the weather and the garden.
Think about the order of the months.
Think about what is coming soon.

inf.title: What Time of Day?
inf.subtitle: Read and think! Find the answer between the lines.
sentences: Kerem is in bed. The sun is up.
Kerem: Good morning, Mum!
At school, Kerem: Good morning, Ms. Hart!
After many lessons, it is lunch time.
In the afternoon, the lessons are over.
Ms. Hart: Have a nice day! See you tomorrow.
At home, the sun is down. It is dark.
Kerem is tired. Kerem: Good night!
It is dark. It is the end of the day!
translations: Birçok dersten sonra öğle yemeği zamanı.
Ms. Hart diyor: İyi günler! Yarın görüşürüz.

questions.q: What time of day does the story begin?
questions.hint: Think about the sun and what Kerem says first.

questions.q: How do we know it is morning?
Why does Kerem say good night?
questions.correct: It is the end of the day
questions.hint: Think about the dark sky and tired Kerem.

questions.q: How do we know it is night?
questions.correct: The sun goes down and it is dark
questions.hint: Read about the sky at home.

questions.q: How does Kerem feel at the end of the day?
questions.hint: Read the sentence before good night.

inf.title: Which Room Is It?
inf.subtitle: Read and think! Find the answer between the lines.
sentences: There is music in the school. Zara is happy.
The lovely sound is from one room.
There is a piano and a drum in this room.
There is a happy song here.
Is this the art room? No!
Is this the gym? No!
There are no balls and no paint here.
There is only music.
What room is it? It is the music room!
translations: Bu odada bir piyano ve bir davul var.
Bu hangi odadır? O müzik odasıdır!

questions.hint: Read about the things in the room.
Think about the piano, drum and song.

questions.q: How do we know it is not the art room?
questions.qTr: Burasının resim odası olmadığını nasıl anlıyoruz?
questions.hint: Think about what is NOT in the room.

questions.q: How do we know it is not the gym?
questions.qTr: Burasının spor salonu olmadığını nasıl anlıyoruz?
questions.hint: Think about what a gym needs.

inf.title: Count the Candles
inf.subtitle: Read and think! Find the answer between the lines.
sentences: There is a cake on the table.
There are eight candles on the cake.
Maya is seven years old.
Leo is nine years old.
Ada is eight years old.
Who is the birthday pupil today?
Count the candles and think!
It is Ada! She is eight years old today.
Happy Birthday, Ada!
translations: Bugün doğum günü olan öğrenci kimdir?
O Ada! O bugün sekiz yaşında.

questions.q: How many candles are on the cake?

questions.hint: The candles show the age. Who is eight?

questions.q: How do we know it is Ada's birthday?
questions.qTr: Ada'nın doğum günü olduğunu nasıl anlıyoruz?
questions.hint: Eight candles and Ada is eight!

inf.title: Who Keeps It Clean?
inf.subtitle: Read and think! Find the answer between the lines.
sentences: Every morning the school is clean and tidy.
The corridor is clean. The classrooms are tidy.
Who is this important person?
Early in the morning, one person is busy at school.
The pupils are not at school.
There is a brush and a big bin.
Maya is in the corridor. He is there, too.
Maya: Thank you! The school is clean!
Who is this person? He is the caretaker, Mr. Cole!
translations: Her sabah okul temiz ve düzenli.
Sabah erkenden bir kişi okulda meşguldür.
Bir fırça ve büyük bir kova var.
Bu kişi kim? O hizmetli, Mr. Cole!

questions.q: What is the school like every morning?

questions.hint: Read about the time before pupils come.

questions.correct: A brush and a big bin
questions.hint: Read about the things he has.
Think about who keeps the school clean.

questions.q: Why does Maya say thank you?
questions.correct: The school is clean because of him

inf.title: Flags Everywhere
inf.subtitle: Read and think! Find the answer between the lines.
sentences: Today the school is different.
There are red and white flags everywhere.
The children are in nice clothes.
There is music and dancing in the sports hall.
It is the 23rd of April.
Kerem: What is today?
Ms. Hart: Think about the flags and the date!
Ada: It is Children's Day!
Yes! Happy Children's Day, everyone!
translations: Her yerde kırmızı ve beyaz bayraklar var.
Spor salonunda müzik ve dans var.
Ms. Hart diyor: Bayrakları ve tarihi düşün!
Evet! Çocuk Bayramı kutlu olsun, herkes!

questions.q: What is different about the school today?

questions.hint: Find the date in the text.
Think about the date, the 23rd of April.

questions.q: How do we know it is a special day?
questions.qTr: Özel bir gün olduğunu nasıl anlıyoruz?
questions.hint: Think about all the things that are different.
Who says it is Children's Day?

inf.title: When Is Her Birthday?
inf.subtitle: Use the clues to find the month!
sentences: Today there is a birthday at school. It is a pupil!
The birthday is not in May.
The birthday is not in July.
The birthday is not in October.
In October, there is a birthday. It is Maya! In January, there is a birthday. It is Ada!
In May, there is a birthday. It is Zara! In July, there is a birthday. It is Kerem!
When is the birthday?
It is in January! It is Ada!
translations: Bugün okulda bir doğum günü var. O bir öğrenci!
Ekimde bir doğum günü var. O Maya! Ocakta bir doğum günü var. O Ada!
Mayısta bir doğum günü var. O Zara! Temmuzda bir doğum günü var. O Kerem!
